caseName: Gulf Oil Corp. v. Corporation Commission
caseNameFull: Gulf Oil Corp. v. Corporation Commission of Oklahoma
attorneys: Richard B. McDermott and James B. Diggs for appellant. Mac Q. Williamson, Attorney General of Oklahoma, Richard M. Huff, Assistant Attorney General, Charles R. Nesbitt and Ferrill H. Rogers for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice Frankfurter, Mr. Justice Douglas, and Mr. Justice Brennan would note probable jurisdiction and set the case for argument.
